label: Client Name
description: Client name for the campaign-reach chart (campaign members carry the client id).
expression: CASE [Campaign_Response].[Client_Id] WHEN 'northstar' THEN 'Northstar Enterprises' WHEN 'vantage' THEN 'Vantage Group' WHEN 'crestline' THEN 'Crestline Partners' WHEN 'meridian' THEN 'Meridian Solutions' WHEN 'helix' THEN 'Helix Industries' ELSE [Campaign_Response].[Client_Id] END
